question: Can PhysicsNeMo predict displacement, von Mises stress and effective plastic strain for held-out initial whole-vehicle geometries at identical rail material, rail thickness and impact condition?

dataset.field_description_status: Producer card only; protected VTP/params were not inspected
dataset.license: cc-by-nc-4.0; inspect actual access terms before consent

geometry.family_scope: Four-parameter morphs of one baseline vehicle; new part topology and different vehicle families are outside this test
geometry.group_rule: Hash exact decimal parameter tuple; all frames, sampling versions and nuisance material variants of each geometry remain in one fold
geometry.isolation_gate: First identify a sufficiently populated exact rail_thickness / rail_yield_strength stratum with identical impact condition; otherwise no geometry-only comparison is available
geometry.extrapolation_label: Audit parameter coverage after metadata; a held-out geometry is not automatically extrapolation

coordinates.physical_frame: Shared undeformed vehicle/world frame; retain dimensions, orientation and relative part positions
coordinates.normalization: One shared affine transform fitted only on training geometries, with a shared scalar spatial scale; retain physical inverse transform
coordinates.out_of_training_domain_policy: Flag and report. Do not clip or refit to test shapes. Resolve fixed FIGConv AABB / adapter range policy before training.
coordinates.existing_normalization_note: benchmark_data.py already computes one train-only bounding box across cases; it is not per-case normalization

inputs.part_ids: Available according to card; mapping/encoding must be verified and shared consistently across models
inputs.meshgraphnet_extra_structure: True FEM surface connectivity; must not connect detached parts solely by Euclidean proximity
inputs.known_condition_scope: Card reports one 56 km/h frontal rigid-wall condition; verify per-case metadata

targets.name: displacement
targets.status: VTP inspection required; contains rigid-body translation

targets.name: von_mises_stress
targets.status: VTP inspection required; verify shell layer/aggregation and node/cell association

targets.name: effective_plastic_strain
targets.status: VTP inspection required; this is not total strain

algorithms.variant: attention_type=GALE_FA; not a separate GeoFLARE class
algorithms.status: existing small adapter only; SHIFT feature contract/resources unverified
needs variable-graph loader and valid coarsening/resource profile
needs shared AABB/OOD policy and all-pairs KNN memory check

comparison.primary_comparable_task: Initial undeformed geometry + known material/thickness + common impact condition + requested physical time -> displacement vector, VM and EPSP at that time; no future ground-truth state at inference
comparison.temporal_implementation_status: Time conditioning and this target contract are not implemented for SHIFT. A direct all-frame head can be an explicitly documented alternative. No temporal strategy is selected as best without results.
comparison.optional_rollout: Separate free-rollout experiment from an allowed initial state, scored over the complete held-out trajectory; teacher-forced test scores must never substitute for free prediction
comparison.decoder_contract: Must predict on declared common physical query support; present adapters predict at input nodes only. Implement and validate transfer/query decoder before density comparisons.
baselines: field-specific zero predictor as a transparent reference, never a successful geometry model
training mean response only if verified node correspondence; otherwise common-query transfer first
geometry-parameter regression on verified comparable field support
POD + RBF only after stable node/cell correspondence and train-only basis verification; otherwise correspondence/field-transfer is a blocking implementation gate
comparison.selection: Validation geometries only; freeze fit/resource budgets after actual profiles; test once after selection
metrics: area-weighted physical-unit MAE/RMSE and relative L2 per field/time/case/part
absolute displacement and centroid-removed deformation reported separately
stress/EPSP peaks, hotspot localization and high-quantile error
unclipped negative VM/EPSP rate and erosion-mask policy
wall time, peak host private memory, peak allocated/reserved VRAM and inference latency
comparison.weights_and_masks: Define surface-area weights, part associations and eroded/active-cell interpolation from the same verified FEM support; do not silently omit failures
comparison.time_zero: Check whether stress/EPSP t0 are absent or physically zero before creating labels

mesh_studies.ai_sampling_density: Same geometry, same FEM truth and common query support; vary only declared point/graph resolution after resource profiling. Hold geometry split and model-selection rules fixed. Include mapping error baseline.
mesh_studies.graph_sampling_gate: Valid graph coarsening preserving disconnected components/parts and connectivity; random deletion of nodes/edges is not a comparable FEM graph
mesh_studies.native_fem_remeshing: Separate unsatisfied study: independently mesh the same physical shape at multiple qualities/resolutions and rerun verified solver with unchanged material/contact/loading. SHIFT morphs alone do not establish convergence.
mesh_studies.same_topology_status: Unverified until connectivity hashes are compared; equal node counts alone are insufficient

execution.resource_gate: Measure import/preprocessing/small forward-backward on admitted host memory; define runtime floor and owned-process cap from measurements before full fits

implementation_gates: Approved gated access and acquired/hashed params; exact raw-to-canonical units and impact-condition mapping
Enough distinct geometries in one fixed material/thickness stratum; otherwise report geometry-only identification failure
Protected VTP parser and bounded out-of-core extraction; verify field association, units, time indexing and erosion semantics
Initial-coordinate, connectivity, part-ID and physical query-support hashes/correspondences
New variable-geometry loader/predictor without weakening frozen old cache/provenance checks
Feature-dimension/time-conditioning/AABB/OOD contracts for all six settings; current adapters are not a ready SHIFT runner
Surface graph coarsening/common-query mapping and sampling-density transfer validation
Resource calibration then explicit hardware, byte caps, subset size, split and fit budget
Actual trained checkpoints, validation-based selection, held-out physical metrics and visual comparison
